sourceText:
Holy Guacamole!
By: Holly Sander
Published: Monday, February 1, 2016 - 1:18pm

Ingredients




3 Ripe Avocados
1 tablespoon finely diced sweet onion (vidalia)
11/2 tablespoons chopped cilantro
1 tablespoon finely diced jalapeño (seeds and membranes removed)
½ teaspoon salt
½ teaspoon garlic powder
1 small lime wedge juiced

Preparation

1 Cut the avocados in half and remove the pits. Use a knife and make three even cuts lengthwise and across the avocado. 2 With a spoon scoop out the flesh into a medium size bowl. Mash the avocados a few times with a fork. 3 Add the cilantro, onions, jalapeños, garlic powder, salt and lime and mix gently together. Don't over mix - there should be several visible chunks of avocado. 4 Enjoy with tortilla chips or warm tortillas.

About

Holy Guacamole! This is the best ever: creamy, buttery avocado with onion, garlic, jalapeños, tomatoes, & lime… You can never have just one bite…it’s completely addictive!
Please visit my blog Taste and See for more delicious recipes!
